findings.title: MSF charity condemns Israeli strike that killed two staff outside Gaza clinic
findings.location: MSF clinic, Gaza City, Gaza Strip
findings.affected_population_system: Reuters footage recorded Saturday shows shrapnel damage to exterior walls at the clinic following the previously logged fatal strike on Friday. Extent of damage, interior damage and service interruption remain unverified. AP additionally quotes a relative saying the two guards were unarmed and in MSF uniforms, and a local MSF employee describing their work at the clinic. These are attributed accounts, not independent verification of civilian status; Israel alleges Hamas affiliation without presenting evidence in the cited reports. No additional fatalities.

findings.source_type: Established wire reporting with direct visual evidence

findings.title: Doctors Without Borders condemns Israeli strike that killed 2 Gaza staff, and other Mideast news
findings.location: Gaza City, Gaza Strip; likely previously logged Al-Rimal incident, precise linkage not established by AP
findings.affected_population_system: AP cites Al-Shifa Hospital reporting one death and several wounded in a Saturday Gaza City strike, consistent with WAFA's multiple-injury account but differing from Anadolu's one wounded. AP also reports the Israeli military said it targeted a militant; no independent confirmation of the deceased person's status. Treat as probable follow-up, not a separate incident or additional casualties. Exact injury count remains unresolved.
